title: From smooth to web
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Slightly denser regions attracted more matter through gravity, helping early differences grow into galaxies, clusters and filaments over cosmic time.
